  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getFittings is called, the client shall return an array of fitting details

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN getFittings returns no results, the client shall return an empty array
    Given a character with no saved fittings is available
    When getFittings is called for the character with no fittings
    Then the client shall return an empty array

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN createFitting is called with valid data, the client shall return the new fitting ID
    Given valid fitting data is provided
    When createFitting is called

    When createFitting is called with the full fitting

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN deleteFitting is called, the client shall complete the operation without error
    Given a valid fitting ID is provided
    When deleteFitting is called

    When createFitting is called without permission

  # EARS: Event-driven
  Scenario: WHEN the full fitting lifecycle is executed, the client shall succeed at each step
    Given a character for the fitting lifecycle test is available
    When createFitting then getFittings then deleteFitting are called in sequence
    Then the client shall succeed at each lifecycle step
"}
